demo.name: Village Builder
about: Villages grow on their own: a Builder villager works out what the village needs, gathers materials, and puts up a real building at dawn. You help by bringing materials.

Place the Builder's Table and open it before anyone takes the job: with no Builder yet, the village plans a Builder's Workshop. Then let the villagers out so one becomes the Builder, put the cobblestone, logs and coal in the table, and mark a spot with the Builder's Flag. It goes up at the next dawn, which can be up to 20 minutes off.
